maddeler.e:
استقضيت (form X)
# اِسْتَقْضَيْتُ (istaqḍaytu) /is.taq.dˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اِسْتَقْضَيْتَ (istaqḍayta) /is.taq.dˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اِسْتَقْضَيْتِ (istaqḍayti) /is.taq.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اُسْتُقْضِيتُ (ustuqḍītu) /us.tuq.dˤiː.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
